text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The average relative decline in monitored wildlife populations. The index value measures the change in
abundance in 35,803 populations across 5,790 native species relative to the year 1970 (i.e. 1970 = 100%).

tspan.tspan: World Wildlife Fund and Zoological Society of London (2026)
Some regions will have experienced significant biodiversity loss prior to 1970; this earlier loss will not be captured in this metric.
